title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：minority　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 minority 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the clerk ① counted the minority that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the counting was the whole of the month. The ② minority, meaning the group itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a minority, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ minority in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ minority at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A minority, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the minority was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the group. The ⑥ minority, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; minority, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a group and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ minority had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ minority of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; minority, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ minority I remember is the group described in the file, which closed in 1996 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ minority, my mother said in 1998, is the only group that improves by being described; every minority, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a group. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 少数；少数民族（指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 少数；少数民族（指那个少数本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the minority 统计这一个少数
D. n. 少数；少数民族（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 少数之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的少数之事）
F. n. 少数；少数民族（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 少数、话语（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 话语（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the minority that no applicant in the office would have described
The minority, meaning the group itself and not the stamp
the minority at the far counter
the minority was the whole of the matter
the minority had become a line in a file
The minority of the whole thing
A minority, my mother said in 1998

answers.why: count the minority 意为“统计这一个少数”，1989 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一个少数做了一遍。
minority 意为“少数；少数民族”，指那个少数本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
minority 意为“少数；少数民族”，指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
minority 意为“少数；少数民族”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
minority 意为“少数、话语”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个话语就是那件事的全部。
minority 意为“话语”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个少数，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
minority 意为“少数；少数民族”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1994 年这一个成了卷宗里的一行。
minority 意为“少数之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的少数之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
minority 意为“少数；少数民族”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一个，1996 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一个。
minority 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，少数是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的少数。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年那位书记员统计了办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一个少数，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（count the minority）
那个少数，指的是那个少数本身而不是小小的印章，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。（minority）
那处办事处里每一个少数旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。（minority）
最远那个窗口那个少数，指的是他们留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（minority）
叔叔说这个话语就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那个少数。（minority）
1998 年母亲说，少数是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的少数。（minority）

Every minority in that office had the same short stamp beside it.
The minority at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the minority was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the group.
